## Verified follow-up: Meta metadata diagnosis and local checks

Evaluated correction SHA: `b246a8fb8762177c502a981a30f80af6a391996b`.

- [Instagram run 34916783980](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34916783980) passes account access, then returns HTTP 400 / API code 2 (`Service temporarily unavailable`) after all three bounded metadata requests. This is a provider-reported error for this request, **not proof of a platform-wide outage or its internal root cause**.
- Read in the signed-in browser: [Meta's v26 debugger reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/reference/v26.0/debug_token) requires credentials associated with the inspected token's app. [Instagram Business Login](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-api-with-instagram-login/business-login/) documents authoritative `expires_in` in exchange/refresh responses, but does not establish Facebook debugger support for this token type. Absence from that guide alone is not proof of unsupported behavior.
- Required operator follow-up: ask the TDF Bot / TDF Bot-IG app administrator or Meta support to confirm the supported metadata inspection flow and investigate code 2. Share only these sanitized run links/error codes, never tokens or token-bearing URLs. Do not assume waiting will resolve it, infer expiry, remove ownership/expiration checks, or rotate working credentials blindly. A further credential change or alternate issuance flow needs explicit approval; Fly remains untouched.
- Backend CI/build failures on `64fd4c8` were the same deterministic missing `selectList` import in `ServerSpec.hs`. The import correction is now pushed in `b246a8f`; local Stack/GHC 9.10.3 has passed that module's type checking, but focused test execution is still pending compilation/linking. [Fresh CI](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34916758923) and [fresh image build](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34916778898) remain pending backend validation.
- Directly verified locally on `64fd4c8`: Node 22.14.0 `npm run quality:repo` passed with generated artifacts unchanged; focused Instagram tests passed 14/14 and CI scope/pipeline tests passed 21/21. These do not certify the full local suite on the newer SHA.

This is an evidence checkpoint, not an all-green completion claim. No merge or auto-merge was performed.

## Post-merge validation and Meta support checkpoint

This is a status update, not an all-green completion claim.

- Initial main: `17a33eca11d585d84435af85340beece9b51d14e`.
- Evaluated correction head: `5bceb329f034cdfadf077f8f2889aa50bd402c7c`.
- GitHub records this PR as merged by `diegueins680` at `2026-09-15T04:11:04Z`, producing current main `73edd77a36c8dcc73e5217303c62376ae684853b`. This session did not submit a merge or enable auto-merge. Both commits have tree `b5efabde9ebc22caebfe61920d6084b63a3e86eb`.
- The complete final-source local quality log now ends in `Quality checks completed`: UI 206 suites / 1,968 tests, mobile 67 suites / 327 tests, backend 2,542 examples / zero failures, and production UI build with 357,591 gzip bytes across five initial preloads. Earlier failed diagnostic runs are not relabeled as passes.
- New-main [Datadog](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34927838904), [catalog authority](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34927838903), and [safe install](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34927838910) are successful. [Build Image](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34927839148) remains in progress at this checkpoint.
- The fresh [artist-enrichment dry-run](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34930085433) **completed successfully** on the exact new-main SHA with `mode=dry-run`, `auto_publish=false`. Its downloaded artifact confirms full scope, 48 profiles, eight inventory candidates, an empty error list, and `haltedBySafetyThreshold=false`. Five MusicBrainz HTTP 503 outcomes were explicitly classified; every affected item has a withholding reason, and zero candidates were published. This records audit progress without publishing profile changes. No production enrichment dispatch was requested.
- Confidential [Meta support case #1978991836117141](https://developers.facebook.com/support/bugs/1978991836117141/) was created with explicit user approval. A fresh browser read confirms **Open**, with no Meta response. The case contains sanitized error codes, app identifiers, run links and an environment-variable-based reproduction; no actual credentials, token-bearing request URLs or attachments were submitted.
- Instagram remains blocked: the [latest correction-SHA check](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34922343353) passed account access but failed metadata inspection with HTTP 400 / API code 2 after bounded retries. The exact provider-side or app-configuration cause is not yet established. No further token rotation, Fly update, bypass of ownership/expiry validation, or repeated rerun was performed.
- Initial-scope PR #331 remains on `49b1a5f2e83e32850f2977cfdede9eb6bc5c4c0c` with all 17 checks successful, but GitHub now reports `CONFLICTING` / `DIRTY` against new main. Its branch has not been rewritten or conflict-resolved by this session.

Next: observe the active main runs; obtain Meta's supported metadata-validation guidance before further credential/configuration changes. A replacement correction PR or a materially different conflict resolution requires user direction because the requested open-PR handoff was changed by an external merge.

The explicitly approved read-only messaging follow-up is open as [PR #370](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/370), head `17c37ee72ff9924b3b153e2cb67bfd6c305b7101`, based on current main `73edd77a36c8dcc73e5217303c62376ae684853b`. It is mergeable, awaiting human review, and has auto-merge disabled.

All five applicable follow-up workflows passed: [CI](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34980022503), [safe install](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34980022398), [catalog](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34980022424), [Datadog](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34980022402), and the [live read-only messaging check](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34980062201). The messaging job verified both token checks while skipping Fly installation and credential maintenance. No token exchange, Fly update or deployment was performed by this follow-up.

The normal [scheduled messaging check on main](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/34978706973) also passed, closing the previously unverified new-main scheduling result. Main still has the older potentially mutating manual `check` implementation until #370 is merged; do not use the old revision for read-only validation.

Original-scope PR #331 is mergeable with all 17 checks successful at its latest verified head `25416b43eb8a24b2a57a180fbb846d9db8addcb1`. The separate Instagram Login metadata failure remains unresolved, with confidential Meta case #1978991836117141 awaiting verified guidance. No further Instagram rerun, credential rotation or validation bypass was performed. The broader audit is not claimed fully complete while that blocker remains.
